Re-measured on the branch binary.
- The command text now carries the split: `reflow2 read add_requirement` is refused by name before anything is opened (exit 1).
- The read set is served on the command line: `reflow2 read --list` gives 78 read and 117 write of 195, with export_graph and export_surface read only without `path`.
- Every --help flag typed after `read` is refused or harmless.
Of the finding's other parts: `--read-only` with `--call` was already honoured (item 1). export_graph and export_surface are still annotated read-only and still write a file given `path`, and `read` refuses them with one. So `^reflow2 read ` now separates door reads from writes, which is what the finding said one rule could not do.
